text_block_list.name: Movie Audio
text_block_list.text: "Aaaaargh..."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hyeeeeeeh~~!!
Save me, Cesario~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, don't be so scared!
It's not like it's gonna jump right out of the screen at you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Look, it seems Messiah and Cesario
understand perfectly well, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Setting me aside, Messiah-san is...
how should I put it, isn't she just frozen stiff?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
choice_data_list: It really is kind of a scary movie...
It really is kind of a scary movie, isn't it...

text_block_list.text:
The reason a zombie movie watch party was being held
in the trainer's office was that I had agreed
to Cesario and the others' request—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. If it isn't an intrusion,
would it be all right if I borrowed your TV...?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to watch a movie with Heart-san and the others,
but the dorm TV is out of order..."
choice_data_list: I don't mind at all. Go and have fun with everyone!
I don't mind at all. Go have fun with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you! Let's get right down
to watching 『Fitness Ghouls』!"

text_block_list.name: Movie Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Aaaaargh..."
"Uuuuurgh..."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, more zombies spawned!?
No way, no way, we can't beat this~~!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"It'll be okay, Craft.
The main characters will figure something out."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Now things are heating up!
A party's gotta be lively! Right?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Messiah-san, shall we hold hands?
Here, you see, I'm sure it'll help you feel at ease...!

text_block_list.name: Movie Audio
text_block_list.text: “““““PHEWWW, YEAAAHHH~~!!”””””

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
What!? Why on earth
are zombies riding jet skis!?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Wah, that's amazing.
I didn't know zombies could do that, too.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...
What incredible physical ability...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Is this really the time to be impressed?
Just look at that terrifying face!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Basking in the wind and laughing happily?!
Even though she's a zombie!!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Th-That's the part you're scared of...?

And—after a series of twists and turns,
"Fitness Ghouls" reached its grand finale.

text_block_list.name: Craft & Messiah
text_block_list.text:
T-That was so scary~!
I-It really scared me...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
To think she even rode a paraglider at the end...
Unbelievable...
choice_data_list: Zombies these days are really something else...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Still, Cesario seemed completely fine, didn't she?
She didn't let out a single scream."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: That's not true, is it? There were some scenes that startled me a bit too.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Really?
You looked like you were having fun the whole time, though...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Maybe... it was because having fun won out over being scared.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Spending lively, bustling time with everyone...
I really love it, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. That explains why your hand felt
even warmer than usual, Cesario-san.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Me too, me too! It was scary, but...
being together with everyone was genuinely so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
For sure!
Fun things are meant to be shared with someone!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Everyone...!
Yeah, let's all watch a movie together again!
choice_data_list: How about a movie that boosts Power next time?
Watching zombie movies really trained my Guts!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Then how about a comedy movie?
I think having a good laugh
will really cheer you up.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that sounds great!
Naturally, popcorn and cola are a must!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Comedy movies are a treasure trove of wild twists...
You might find the clue you need to break through!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Nice, nice, tomorrow sounds great!
Trainer, please let me borrow the TV again!
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'd like to see it too.
Yeah, I wanna see it too.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Wah...!
I'll introduce my recommended movies!
I hope everyone likes them too!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"True...
Oh, maybe this could be good training?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Then why not watch a shark movie next?
There's one called "Sharkmare"
about fighting a shark in a dream."

text_block_list.name: Craft & Messiah
text_block_list.text: No waaaay!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha...
That looks harsher than any training regimen.
